newsitem.title: FRANCE: Daewoo could float part of Thomson Multimedia.
newsitem.headline: Daewoo could float part of Thomson Multimedia.

text.p: Daewoo Electronics chairman Soon-hoon Bae told a parliamentary committee on Tuesday afternoon that his group could float part of Thomson Multimedia when the consumer electronics group is back in the black.

Francois-Michel Gonnot, chairman of the parliament commission, said Bae had told the parliamentarians that Daewoo would invest 13 billion francs in the company of which five billion would be invested over the next five years.
Bae also said he expected Thomson Multimedia to get a part of the 11 billion state cash injection to the Thomson group but did not disclose how much he expected from the government.
The French government intends to sell state-owned Thomson SA to Lagardere Groupe for one franc after an 11 billion franc capital increase.
Lagardere will keep defence electronics company Thomson-CSF and sell Thomson Multimedia for one franc to Daewoo.
France's Privatisation Commission still has to approve the deal and the independent commission of experts is awaiting the European Commission's approval for the cash injection.
